remarks: Welcome to this spacious and sun-filled 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo offering 1,057 sq feet, stunning city views and an unbeatable location in the heart of Stamford, CT. Situated in a well-maintained doorman building, this oversized unit features an eat-in kitchen, abundant closet space, and a smart layout perfect for comfortable living and entertaining.  Enjoy the convenience of a garage with visitor parking, elevator access, and secure entry - all designed for a low-maintenance lifestyle. Whether you're hosting or unwinding, the generous living and dining area offers flexibility and flow.  Just steps from Stamford's vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment scene, this condo puts everything at your fingertips. With easy access to transit and major highways, it's ideal for commuters and urban explorers alike.
